item.title: Tailwing 1.0.0-rc.4
item.description:
Tailwing 1.0.0 RC 4

Notes and write-ups are typeset for reading. Lines are a comfortable length, with spacing set for each look, bullets that hang in the margin, curly quotes and proper dashes, and figures that line up. Names with accents, such as Michał or Ștefan, now set in one typeface. Terminal stays dense and functional.

A meeting that appears on two of your calendars, or that a calendar tool copied from one to another, now shows as one meeting. Invites from other people are never merged into your own meetings, and a merge never changes a meeting's join link.

You can choose where alerts appear: automatically, under the Tailwing icon in the menu bar, at the top right or at the top left. Settings opens in its own window instead of as a tab, and the template choices explain what each one is for.

item.title: Tailwing 1.0.0-rc.3
item.description:
Tailwing 1.0.0 RC 3

Live coaching works again, and you can see it. It counts the whole call and its nudges fire, showing by the camera: tucked into the notch on a MacBook, or at the top of the call's screen on an external monitor. You can drag it anywhere. It runs on your Mac with the local model and stays out of screen shares. Coaching from Parafoil.

While notes are being taken, the menu bar shows a ring instead of words. A trackpad tap can come with each nudge if you turn it on.

Settings has been tidied. Every row has an icon and states its setting in words, each tab opens with a line explaining what it is for, there is a search box, and anything that reaches the internet is labelled "Uses the internet". In Next steps, Things now shows as Ready or Not installed.

New installs dictate with Left Control. If you have already chosen a key, it is kept. This release also includes RC 2.2's fix for dictation after sleep.

item.title: Tailwing 1.0.0-rc.2.1
item.description:
Tailwing 1.0.0 RC 2.1

A fix for dictation. In RC 2, holding the dictation key could end with "Held too briefly" even after a long hold, because the recording sometimes didn't reach Tailwing. Dictation is back to the way it worked in RC 1, with RC 2's clearer messages: a press that really was too short says so, and if the microphone doesn't start, the pill says that instead. The faster start from RC 2 comes back in a later release once it's fixed.

item.title: Tailwing 1.0.0-rc.2
item.description:
Tailwing 1.0.0 RC 2

Dictation that always answers. The dictation key is now heard on its own thread, so a busy Tailwing can't miss it, and the pill appears the moment you press. Recording starts straight away, so your first words are kept while the speech model gets ready, and dictation never waits behind a meeting being transcribed. A press that's ignored now says why on the pill: another key was pressed, it was held too briefly, or another app is protecting typing. Settings, Shortcuts tells you if another app may take the same key.

Choose your dictation sound in Settings, Dictation: Beep, Mechanical, Chime or Walkie-Talkie.

During a call, Flag This Moment marks a moment, with a note if you like, and the write-up gives flagged parts more weight. Catch Me Up summarizes the last few minutes, or everything since you joined. After the call, send next steps to Reminders, or with Pro to Things or Todoist.

The brief before a meeting suggests questions to ask, and write-ups have an Open questions section. The calendars already on your Mac are now the first, recommended choice in setup.

Right-click anyone in People to rename them, or to merge them with someone else. Ask is now called Ask Tailwing. Each look's tile shows its name, and the chosen one is highlighted.

A meeting on more than one of your calendars now shows once. Before an update installs, Tailwing checks for a newer one, so you always get the latest.

item.title: Tailwing 1.0.0-rc.1
item.description:
Tailwing 1.0.0 RC 1

This is the release candidate for Tailwing 1.0: everything from the betas, with live coaching, private meetings that name no one, your own shortcuts and one-click AI tools.

Tailwing's own writing model now talks to the app over a private connection inside Tailwing's folder on this Mac, instead of a local network port. Nothing about how notes are written changes.

A fix to how a change of microphone mid-call is reported.
